public_rationale: Contemporaneous independent research found successful prompt matches alongside frequent relational failures. MIT's September report also describes attribute-binding errors in DALL-E 2. These findings support Marcus's general observation that correspondence with linguistic input was uneven. They do not establish identical behavior across all systems or a failure rate for the exact horse-and-astronaut examples.
limitations: The strongest experimental evidence covers DALL-E 2.
The relational study was a preprint.
These output tests do not by themselves establish whether a system understands the world.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Image synthesis systems only inconsistently match their linguistic input to the images produced, doing well on some prompts and poorly on others.

statement.excerpt: On #2, the answer is mixed. They do well on some inputs (like astronaut rides horse) but more poorly on others (like horse rides astronaut, which I discussed in an earlier post).
statement.document_title: Form, function, and the giant gulf between drawing a picture and understanding the world

our_interpretation: The plain reading is uneven correspondence between prompts and generated images, including difficulty with relationships and role reversals.
The horse examples illustrate the general claim; they do not assert that every generation of either prompt must have the same result.
The surrounding discussion concerns the generation of systems available since DALL-E 2 appeared in 2022, through the post date. April through September 18 is the assessment window.
Support requires documented successes as well as failures, rather than attractive images alone.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous evaluations document successful prompt matching alongside substantial failures on other prompts, especially compositional or relational instructions.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative contemporaneous evaluations show consistently accurate correspondence across ordinary and relational prompts, with the alleged failure pattern absent.
